content: Ta hintewunne Loodoqe kataman de7iya asaas, hessadaka tana ayfen be7iboona asa ubbaas ay mela baaxetiyako hinte erana mela koyayis.
Ta baaxetiya gaasoyka enti banta wozanan minnidi, siiqon qashetidi, polo gidida kumetha akeeka duretetha demmidi Xoossaa xuuraa Kiristoosa erana melasa.
Iyan Xoossay minjida eraynne cincatetha ubbay de7ees.
Ta hessa oonika hintena cimo qaalan balethonna mela koyada gayis.
Ta hintefe haakada de7ikoka ayyaanan hintera de7ayis. Hinte duussaa maaranne Kiristoosa hinte minnidi ammaneysa be7ada ufaytayis.
Kiristoosan Kumetha De7o
Hinte Godaa Kiristoos Yesuusa ekidaysada iyan de7ite.
Iyan xapho yeddite; iyan keexetite. Hinte tamaaridaysada ammanon minnite; Xoossaas kumidi palahida galataa immite.
Kiristoosape gidonashin, asa woganinne ha alamiya coo wogan katida timirteninne asape yida eratethan oonika hintena cimi balethidi di77onna mela naagetite.
Xoossaa Xoossatethay Kiristoosa asatethan kumethi de7ees.
Hinteka maatasinne wolqa ubbaas huuphe gidiya Kiristoosan kumideta.
Hinte Kiristoosa ammanidi qaxaretideta. Hessika asa kushen gidonashin, hintena iita hanotethaafe diggiya Kiristoosan oosetida qaxaretethi.
Hinte xammaqetida wode Kiristoosara issife moogetidi, Kiristoosa hayqope denthida Xoossaa wolqaa ammanidi, Kiristoosara issife dendideta.
Hinte, hinte nagaraa gishonne hinte ceega asatethaa qaxaretonna gisho hayqidi de7ishin, Xoossay hinte nagaraa atto gis. Kiristoosara hintew de7o immis.
I nuna mootiyanne nuura eqetiya, nu bolla xaafetida acuwa daakidi masqaliya bolla dhishidi ogepe diggis.
Kiristoosi wolqatanne maatata masqaliyan xoonidi, enta ola dancuwa bilisidi, di7etida asada enta qoncen yuushshi bessis.
Hessa gisho, miyaban woyko uyaaban, ba7aale gallas woyko ageeni xeeriya qamma bonchon oonika hinte bolla pirdofo.
Haysati sinthafe yaanaw de7iyabatas eesho, shin tumay Kiristoosa.
Qoodhepe qommo ashketethaninne kiitancho goyinnon ceeqetiya oonika hintena hinte woytuwape ashshofo. Hessa mela asi ba be7ida qoncethan nashetishe ba asho qofan coo otortees.
Hessa mela asaas huuphe gidida Kiristoosara gahetethi baawa. I asatethaa ubbaa shayaninne keson keson gathi oythidi muzidi dichees. Xoossay hessa mela ogen asatethaa ubbaas dichi immees.
Ooratha De7o
Hinte Kiristoosara hayqidi ha alamiya haariya ayyaanata wolqaafe la77a keydeta. Yaatin, ayis shaaketonna asada gididi ha wogatas haretetii?
He wogati, “Oykofa; laacofa; bochofa” geeteteysata.
Ha ubbay asa woganne timirte gidiya gisho ooso bolla pee7idaape guye dhayana.
Ha kiitati bonchonne cincatethi daanidi bentanaw danda7oosona. Ha wogati Xoosse daro dosisiyaba, ashkenne hinte asatethaa haarisiyaba daanosona, shin nu iita amotetha bolla entaw wolqi baawa.
